item.title: Samson's 57 off 22 establishes his role of preferred opener as India seal series
item.description: Sanju Samson showcased his incredible skills, leading India to a triumphant T20 series win against Afghanistan with a blistering fifty-seven runs in just twenty-two balls. He was well-supported by Abhishek Sharma, who added thirty-eight not out. Meanwhile, the impressive bowling from Nitish Kumar Reddy eased the coaching staff’s worries, while the stellar performance of Samson and Sharma indicates a tough challenge ahead for the younger players.
item.dc:creator: ARANI BASU

item.title: 'Should be laughed out': T Mobile CFO on Musk's 'Starlink plan' for mobile industry
item.description: T-Mobile's CFO Peter Osvaldik stated Starlink Mobile is not a serious wireless threat. He criticized SpaceX's changing strategy and proposed infrastructure plans. Satellites face physical limitations in urban environments, blocking signals. SpaceX's plan for numerous small cell stations is deemed impractical by T-Mobile. Therefore, Starlink's challenge to traditional telecom operators is not currently convincing.

item.title: Ohio turned former glass factory into 250-acre park with quarry lakes
item.description: Mount Vernon's Ariel-Foundation Park now spans 250 acres, blending industrial remnants with natural beauty. A historic smokestack, once part of a glass factory, now serves as an observation tower. Three large lakes were created from former gravel quarries, enhancing the landscape. Walking trails connect various park features and extend to other recreational networks. This adaptive reuse project successfully transformed a deteriorating factory site into a recognizable public space.

item.title: Egyptian Mummy left 'screaming' for 3,000 years
item.description: A remarkable discovery in Thebes reveals an ancient Egyptian mummy with a haunting, frozen scream. Researchers employing cutting-edge technology examined this 3,000-year-old remains and struggled to identify the woman’s cause of death. Experts theorize that a sudden occurrence led to cadaveric spasm, preserving her expression, hinting at a tragic demise in great suffering.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Tennessee siblings turned 852-acre family property into protected conservation land
item.description: In a significant conservation move, The Land Trust for Tennessee has permanently protected an expansive 852-acre estate. Siblings Mary Ann and John Sugg dedicated years to revitalizing farmland into lush forest. Their generous donation guarantees the landscape's preservation from future commercial development. Employing contemporary forestry techniques, the land trust oversees the property, ensuring a sustainable environmental legacy for generations to come.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: 'Our father being slowly killed': Imran Khan's sons accuse Asim Munir of vendetta
item.description: Imran Khan's sons publicly claim that army chief Asim Munir is engaging in a personal vendetta against their father. They voice serious concerns over Khan's prison conditions, labeling them as torture. For more than six months, the sons have been unable to contact their father, and they worry about his neglected eye condition, which could lead to significant vision impairment. However, the Pakistani government dismisses these allegations as unfounded propaganda.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Omar praises India’s foreign policy over Brics mention of Pahalgam, slams Centre on UCC
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir' chief minister Omar Abdullah commended India’s diplomatic achievements at the recent Brics summit. He highlighted the group's unified condemnation of the Pahalgam terrorist attack. Furthermore, Abdullah expressed concerns about the central government's strategy in implementing the Uniform Civil Code and asserted that such pivotal legislation ought to be decided by Parliament, rather than through isolated state actions that circumvent legislative norms.
item.dc:creator: NASEER GANAI

item.title: Rafael Nadal vs Maria Francisca Perello net worth: Who is richer in 2026?
item.description: Rafael Nadal and Maria Francisca Perello have built a financially successful household in different ways. Nadal’s fortune is still considerably larger, thanks to tennis prize money, endorsements, investments and businesses built during and after his playing career. Perello has taken a lower-profile professional route, including work related to the Rafa Nadal Foundation, while supporting the family’s broader business and philanthropic pursuits.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Roger Federer’s $8.1M mansion: Why did he sell his Lake Zurich home?
item.description: Roger Federer’s former Wollerau glass mansion near Lake Zurich was built as a private family home and was reportedly worth about $8.1 million. He listed it for 5.4 million Swiss francs in 2017 and sold it in 2018. Federer later focused on his much larger Rapperswil-Jona waterfront estate, where construction has faced several delays and disputes.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Ed Sheeran's opening acts quit tour in solidarity with Macklemore
item.description: Four of Ed Sheeran's supporting acts have quit his tour abruptly. This decision came after rapper Macklemore was removed for pro-Palestinian remarks. Irish acts Aaron Rowe and Beoga, and Lukas Graham are leaving the tour. Finneas, Billie Eilish's collaborator, also withdrew from his South American dates. These artists expressed solidarity with Palestine and its people.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Fee on UPI payments above Rs 2,000: Who pays and what changes for you
item.description: Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) is essentially a fee that a merchant incurs when accepting payments for goods or services through credit or debit cards. It is important to note that person-to-person transactions will continue to be free with no MDR applicable.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: US grandpa's $100K treehouse becomes $325K backyard castle
item.description: What started as a simple backyard play area vision transformed into a stunning treehouse sanctuary. Priced at $325,000, this remarkable creation boasts a pirate ship and an exciting zipline. Meticulously designed by professional engineers, the treehouse prioritizes safety and the health of the trees. Its multi-tiered layout offers cozy lofts perfect for family bonding and unforgettable gatherings, making it an enduring family attraction filled with wonder and creativity.

item.title: His flat faced water leaks for 8 years; court orders neighbour to allow repairs
item.description: This water leakage problem between two neighbours in a housing society turned into an eight-year legal battle, with the Maharashtra Co-operative Appellate Court eventually directing the owner of the first-floor flat to allow repairs in his home.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Neighbours over-trimmed trees for lake view; judge orders $34,064 damages
item.description: A British Columbia woman allowed her neighbours to trim some trees in 2021, but they cut far more than she had permitted to improve their view of Shuswap Lake. A court found the neighbours liable for trespass and ordered them to pay $34,064 for replacement trees, a shade structure and two air conditioning units.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Formerly enslaved man founded Illinois town; 191 years later, land joins NPS
item.description: The Hampshire House in Manhattan has seen its unfinished penthouse sell for $6.765 million, a staggering reduction of 83% from its original listing of $40 million. This raw attic space demanded substantial work to become livable. After years of challenges and strategic efforts, it was sold through an online auction, highlighting the complexities of luxury real estate dealings in New York City.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Holly Rowe responds to Arch Manning: What did she say after his AI joke?
item.description: Holly Rowe has responded after former ESPN colleague Cindy Brunson defended her following Arch Manning’s comments about a fake AI video. Manning called the clip “hilarious” after Texas beat Ohio State. Brunson criticized those who laughed and praised Rowe for helping women in sports media. Rowe thanked Brunson publicly, keeping her response brief while the debate continued online.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Lalbaugcha Raja: How a broken market and a vow created Mumbai’s iconic Ganpati
item.description: Lalbaugcha Raja started from a community's heartfelt desire for a thriving marketplace. This wish materialized into a public Ganesha idol in 1934, granting countless devotees their aspirations. The Kambli family has been sculpting the Raja's iconic visage for three generations. With millions waiting for darshan, this enduring emblem of collective faith continues to inspire hope across generations.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Sanju Samson joins Rohit Sharma, KL Rahul in India's elite club
item.description: The Kerala batter was a key player in India's T20 World Cup triumph, but his form has been inconsistent since then. He had scored only 33 runs in four innings before the Afghanistan series. With youngster Vaibhav Sooryavanshi also pushing for a place, Samson needed a strong performance. The upcoming Asian Games also added to the importance of his form.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: ‘Aapko jaanta hi kaun hai’: Biker Sia hits back at gym owner’s ‘victim card’ remark
item.description: Shivani Chauhan at the center of a Gurgaon road-rage incident has spoken out against the accused gym owner. She stated that her identity was not widely known before the media reported the incident. The woman, who previously contested an election, is now taking a strong stance on the matter. She detailed her alleged harassment and chase, believing it could have been fatal.
item.dc:creator: PRACHI KUMAWAT

item.title: How fish has BJP's plate full in West Bengal
item.description: Amidst the ongoing conversation regarding dietary customs within Hinduism during Durga Puja, chief minister Suvendu Adhikari engaged in prayer and enjoyed traditional bhog. He asserted that faith-based dietary choices should remain personal, asserting his own commitment to sattvik eating on designated days while also accepting fish and goat meat as temple prasad, demonstrating a multicultural approach.
item.dc:creator: PALLAVI

item.title: Pittsburgh’s last steel mill closed in 1998; 178 acres are being transformed
item.description: After decades of lying vacant, Pittsburgh’s former steel mill site Hazelwood Green is finally seeing major redevelopment. Since 2022, around 700,000 square feet has been developed or is under construction, including Carnegie Mellon’s robotics centre, Pitt’s BioForge facility, housing, parks and a football field. More technology, retail and housing projects are planned across the 178-acre riverfront site.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: New York covered Lake George with 700 mats; 97% of invasive clams died
item.description: In 2011, Lake George took significant action against its invasive Asian clam issue by implementing a large-scale benthic barrier treatment, which successfully eliminated ninety-seven percent of clams in a five-acre area. However, by 2019, these clams made a comeback, with twenty-seven sites identified. Consequently, efforts have shifted to monitoring their spread and impact on the ecosystem.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Gurgaon hit-and-run: Stalking, attempt to murder charges slapped on Kalyan Bainsla
item.description: A gym owner was arrested for ramming his car into a woman biker. The accused allegedly made indecent comments and attempted to kill the victim. Police apprehended the suspect in Rajasthan after a two-day search operation. He was booked under attempt-to-murder and stalking charges following the incident. The victim stated she was targeted due to her gender and could have died.
item.dc:creator: PRACHI KUMAWAT

item.title: Inside Gisele Bündchen’s $9.1m Florida ranch with 10 horse stalls
item.description: Supermodel Gisele Bündchen has made a stunning investment in Florida, acquiring a vast 7.5-acre equestrian estate priced at $9.1 million. This impressive property includes ten horse stalls and even a full-sized soccer field, catering to her passion for horses and outdoor activities. With nine bedrooms and significant renovations complete, this estate adds to her expanding real estate portfolio, perfect for luxurious living amidst nature.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: San Francisco mall may get 6 basketball courts, 8 volleyball courts and school
item.description: A bold proposal seeks to convert San Francisco Centre into a vibrant sports complex, featuring state-of-the-art basketball and volleyball courts alongside a dedicated sports high school. Retail and dining options will continue to serve the community, drawing in visitors for both recreation and education. This innovative plan has the potential to breathe new life into the once-bustling downtown mall.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Travis Kelce retirement: What did he say after breaking records vs Broncos?
item.description: Travis Kelce, the Kansas City Chiefs’ tight end, has opened up about the retirement rumors and has cleared the air on it in the new season.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Harry Potter star Johnny Flynn says private schools should be ‘burnt to the ground’
item.description: Harry Potter star Johnny Flynn has opened up about his traumatic experience at Winchester’s Pilgrims’ School, where he was bullied after entering boarding school at seven. The actor developed nervous tics and later underwent therapy, which helped him understand “boarding school syndrome”. Flynn said he does not think private schools should exist.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: India’s exports to US, China surge in August amid stronger global trade
item.description: India's merchandise exports to the US and China saw significant growth in August. Shipments to the US increased by over twenty-one percent while China saw a fifty-two percent rise. Overall exports climbed by more than twenty-six percent, driven by key sectors. Imports also grew, with electronics and crude oil shipments increasing substantially. This performance narrowed the merchandise trade deficit to its lowest in five months.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: FDA suspends licences of Mumbai's iconic Cafe Mondegar, 3 others over safety violations
item.description: The Maharashtra FDA has taken decisive action by suspending licenses of well-known restaurants and food joints due to severe hygiene breaches. Recent inspections uncovered alarming failures in food storage and sanitation. During a focused drive for the festive season in Mumbai and Maharashtra, thousands of kilograms of questionable food have been confiscated, prompting legal proceedings against several non-compliant food business operators.
item.dc:creator: ANJALI SINGH

item.title: IndiGo Agartala-Delhi flight diverted to Lucknow after smoke warning in cargo area
item.description: An IndiGo flight from Agartala to Delhi diverted to Lucknow after a smoke warning. The aircraft landed safely with all 103 passengers and six crew members unharmed. Airport emergency teams were deployed as a precautionary measure following the alert. This incident follows a similar diversion of an Air India Express flight days earlier. Both aircraft landed safely, and no smoke was found during inspections.
item.dc:creator: ARVIND CHAUHAN

item.title: Canada will be ‘stronger, more resilient, more independent’ after US trade war: Carney
item.description: Canada aims for economic resilience and independence from trade disputes. New tax incentives will encourage private investment in Canadian businesses. The nation is also seeking deeper economic ties with the European Union. This strategy aims to reduce dependence on the United States market. Canada remains open to future mutually beneficial agreements with Washington.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA
